## CUTANEOUS ABSCESS
Incise and drain then cover the site with a dry dressing. For small abscesses,
systemic antimicrobial therapy is rarely necessary.
If the patient is neutropenic, has multiple lesions, or has fever or
leukocytosis, antimicrobial treatment may be necessary. Contact Infectious
Diseases for assistance.
## For the few CUTANEOUS ABSCESSES away from the rectal area that need a systemic
